witnesses.name: proof_of_cmc_compile_entail_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Choose a whole-goal disjunct. Unfold cm_program_rep, cm_program_heap_rep and cm_output_pre, retaining the original function pointer, three buffer pointers and three old scalar values as existential witnesses. Open cm_program_context_rep only enough to obtain program_pre<>0, then refold it. Obtain capacity upper bounds from the two #Int field resources, not from cm_output_pre's pure conjunct alone. cm_semantic_wf_program unfolds to the required cm_wf_program; its typed projection gives cmc_data_ready_from_typed, cmc_structs_ready_from_typed, cm_concrete_code_ready_from_wf and cm_concrete_functions_ready_from_wf. Destructure these established readiness conclusions to obtain all data sizes, safety facts and the data-length equality. Reintroduce the same witnesses and cancel the unchanged context, function list, output fields and undefined buffers.

witnesses.name: proof_of_cmc_compile_entail_wit_2
witnesses.strategy: Choose the whole-goal first disjunct and keep the existing functions_ptr_2, ops_ptr_2, imms_ptr_2 and data_ptr_2. The guards and length-return equalities establish model lengths <= capacities; cm_i32_code_count establishes nonnegativity. Establish code_capacity>0 using the counts-representable projection of cm_wf_program, cm_functions_length_bound__model_length_bound, Zlength_nonneg and cm_model_code_length=11+functions_size. Establish data_capacity>=8 from the recorded model-data-size equality and nonnegative globals/strings sizes. The positive capacities select the nonempty branches of cm_undef_int_buffer, cm_undef_int64_buffer and cm_undef_uint8_buffer, exposing all three nonzero pointers and full undefined arrays. Rewrite full to the zero-based undefined segment and introduce each empty initialized segment using the library empty-segment identity. Carry the existing pure facts and cancel the context/output fields.

witnesses.name: proof_of_cmc_compile_entail_wit_5
witnesses.strategy: Choose a whole-goal disjunct and unfold cm_program_context_rep. Its existing structs/globals/strings pointers, functions_ptr_2 and data_ptr_2 instantiate the RHS existentials. The context owns exactly the five program fields and three descriptor lists required on the RHS; retain the function list and frame cm_emitter_rep and every output/data resource. All pure facts are hypotheses. This is a context-open transition with no change to code or data values.

witnesses.name: proof_of_cmc_compile_entail_wit_3
witnesses.strategy: Choose the whole first disjunct. Preserve functions_ptr_2 and data_ptr_2. Fold cm_resolved_emitter_plan_rep, cm_resolved_emitter_rep and cm_emitter_rep using raw_prefix=[] and existing ops/imms pointers. cm_patch_code []=[] and the two representation lists are empty, so pc=0 and both zero-based buffer segments match exactly. Prove the plan budget by app_nil_r, Zlength_nil and cm_compile_model_length__emitter_transitions, rewriting the given code_length=model length and code_length<=code_capacity. Nonzero pointers/output and all bounds already occur in the antecedent. Frame the context, function list, data buffers and remaining output fields.

witnesses.name: proof_of_cmc_compile_entail_wit_4
witnesses.strategy: Choose a whole-goal disjunct; normalize []++cm_model_code to cm_model_code. Unfold only cm_resolved_emitter_plan_rep, discard its now-unneeded pure budget, and retain the enclosed cm_resolved_emitter_rep unchanged. Instantiate functions_ptr and data_ptr by functions_ptr_2 and data_ptr_2, propagate the hypotheses and cancel the context and framed output/data resources. Do not unfold or reprove the resolved raw-code relation.

witnesses.name: proof_of_cmc_compile_entail_wit_6
witnesses.strategy: Use the whole first disjunct. Open cm_emitter_rep to obtain its ops/imms pointers, nonzeroness, output fields, local emitter fields and both initialized/undefined segment pairs. Rewrite Zlength(cm_rep_ops model_code) using Zlength_map and cm_compile_model_length__emitter_transitions to the hypothesis code_length; use the same map-length equality for imms. Refold cm_program_context_rep with the existing structs_ptr/globals_ptr/strings_ptr and functions_ptr_2. Rewrite the emitted-data endpoint to data_length using the given model-data-size equality, and the byte list to cm_model_data_bytes by its definition (zeros 8 is the same repeat prefix). The return equality gives retval=data_length. Instantiate functions_ptr/ops_ptr/imms_ptr, retain all nonzero and length facts, and cancel the reconstructed context, output fields, emitter fields and the three segment pairs.

helpers.name: cm_compile_functions_length__emitter_transitions
helpers.strategy: Prove forall policy p functions fid, Zlength(cm_emit_functions policy p fid functions)=cm_functions_code_size policy p functions fid. No well-formedness premise is needed: induct on functions with fid generalized, unfold the two recursors, rewrite Zlength_app and the existing cm_layout_function_length, then use the induction hypothesis at fid+1.

helpers.name: cm_compile_model_length__emitter_transitions
helpers.strategy: Prove forall policy p, Zlength(cm_model_code policy p)=cm_model_code_length policy p. Unfold cm_model_code and cm_model_code_length, rewrite Zlength_app and cm_compile_functions_length__emitter_transitions, and compute the prelude length as 11. This premise-free public fact is used by entail witnesses 3 and 6.

split_strategies.proof_of_cmc_compile_return_wit_1_split_: Fold cm_program_rep/cm_program_heap_rep using the existing semantic-wf hypothesis, functions_ptr and context/function-list resources. Open cm_output_ok on the RHS and use existing ops_ptr, imms_ptr and data_ptr. The model-length equalities and capacity bounds supply its numeric conjuncts; cmc_compile_success_bridge supplies its universally quantified source-termination/output-decoding implication with precisely the semantic-wf hypothesis. Convert each initialized/undefined segment pair using the corresponding planned prefix helper; each helper extracts Zlength values=endpoint from seg_Zlength, so this group needs no new model-code-length lemma from a sibling. Rewrite output scalar fields by the existing length equalities, retain entry=0, and cancel the eight output fields and three prefix buffers.

helpers.name: cm_compile_int_prefix__success_result
helpers.strategy: Prove forall ptr capacity n values, ptr<>0 -> 0<=n<=capacity -> IntArray.seg ptr 0 n values ** IntArray.undef_seg ptr n capacity |-- cm_int_prefix_buffer ptr capacity values. Extract Zlength values=n using IntArray.seg_Zlength. Unfold the prefix predicate and split n=0: for zero, the initialized segment is emp and the undefined segment equals undef_full (capacity=0 reduces to emp); for nonzero, fold IntArray.full and rewrite undef_seg_0_shift to obtain undef_full at ptr+n*4 of length capacity-n. All premises are explicit return-VC hypotheses.

helpers.name: cm_compile_int64_prefix__success_result
helpers.strategy: Prove forall ptr capacity n values, ptr<>0 -> 0<=n<=capacity -> Int64Array.seg ptr 0 n values ** Int64Array.undef_seg ptr n capacity |-- cm_int64_prefix_buffer ptr capacity values. Follow the segment-length/zero/nonzero proof of the Int prefix helper with Int64Array identities and element width 8; no assumptions about model code or sibling helpers are required.

helpers.name: cm_compile_uint8_prefix__success_result
helpers.strategy: Prove forall ptr capacity n values, ptr<>0 -> 0<=n<=capacity -> UCharArray.seg ptr 0 n values ** UCharArray.undef_seg ptr n capacity |-- cm_uint8_prefix_buffer ptr capacity values. Follow the segment-length/zero/nonzero proof with UCharArray identities and element width 1. The data pointer nonzeroness and data-length capacity bounds are present in the split goal.

split_strategies.proof_of_cmc_compile_return_wit_2_split_: Fold cm_program_rep/cm_program_heap_rep with functions_ptr and the semantic-wf hypothesis. Fold cm_output_capacity with the existing ops_ptr/imms_ptr/data_ptr and nonnegative capacities/output nonzeroness. Rewrite retval and retval_2 to the model lengths. Select the right side of the capacity-overflow disjunction from retval_2>data_capacity. Cancel all eight output fields, entry=-1 and the unchanged three undefined buffers; no array transformations or new helper are needed.

split_strategies.proof_of_cmc_compile_return_wit_3_split_: Fold the program heap/semantic representation and cm_output_capacity with the original pointers. Rewrite retval and retval_2 to the model code/data lengths, and select the left side of the overflow disjunction using retval>code_capacity. Output nonzeroness and capacity nonnegativity are explicit hypotheses. Cancel the context/function list, unchanged output fields with entry=-1, and three undefined buffers.
